item.title: DNA and vehicle-tracking help French investigators recover stolen Renoirs
item.description: DNA left on a protective painting cover helped investigators recover two stolen Renoirs and uncover what they suspected were preparations for another art heist, a French prosecutor said Monday.
item.content:encoded:
DNA left on a protective painting cover helped investigators recover two stolen Renoirs and uncover what they suspected were preparations for another art heist, a French prosecutor said Monday.

item.description: Ukraine's leader says Russia is continuing to attack Ukraine and is ignoring an "energy ceasefire" declared by President Trump.

item.title: Many Iranians who go to Turkey to find jobs are exploited
item.description: Desperate Iranians are finding work in Turkey to make ends meet, but many are being exploited and left with nothing but more debt.

item.title: Both Russia and Ukraine are using AI-powered drones on the battlefield
item.description: A Ukrainian company that got rich making smartphone-controlled cameras to watch pets at home now outfits first-person-view drones with an image recognition system powered by artificial intelligence.

item.title: India's opposition parties march to top court as protests over voter lists escalate
item.description: Opposition parties say revisions to the list of eligible voters favor Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party. Authorities have removed more than 130 million names from the voter roll.

item.title: Russia hits Ukraine gas facilities after Trump claims 'energy ceasefire'
item.description: Trump said he had brokered a cease-fire to protect energy infrastructure in Russia and Ukraine. But Ukrainian officials say bombs kept falling overnight on gas facilities, wounding 33 people.

item.title: Seafarer's union official says crews offered big money to transit Strait of Hormuz
item.description: As attacks continue to mount on shipping vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, a seafarer's union official says some crews are being offered big rewards for making the crossing.
